role: indexed individual variable
notes: The original countable variable alphabet; substitutions are capture avoiding.

role: formulas with free variables among the first n slots
notes: Also the source formula prealgebra with its equivalence relation.

role: source validity of a formula's universal closure
notes: Explicit semantic standing in this source presentation rather than an undeclared proof-system turnstile.

role: equivalence of formulas in every model of T
notes: Preserves the source's equivalence quotient; elementary equivalence of structures remains a different relation.

role: Boolean quotient of the finite-variable formula prealgebra
notes: Nonzero elements correspond to consistent formulas.

role: formulas serving as atoms or consistent nonzero elements
notes: Their particular consistency and atom assumptions are specified before each use.

role: formula used in a consistency-refinement calculation
notes: Chosen outside the complete type in the nonprincipal branch; quotient representatives are understood in algebra calculations.

role: complete finite-tuple type as a dual prime ideal
notes: The source ideal direction is the ultrafilter direction.

role: set of complete dual prime ideals of the n-variable algebra
notes: Identified with the existing complete-type space only by the proved algebra/type correspondence.

role: tuples realizing every member of the complete type
notes: Repeated coordinates are permitted; omission means this set is empty.

role: sentence obtained by naming the free-variable slots
notes: Bound variables are freshened when making or reversing the named instance.

role: complete theory with a realizing tuple named
notes: Consists of the base theory and the named type instances.

role: basic clopen set of types containing the formula
notes: An empty set exactly when the formula is inconsistent.

role: countable set of fresh Henkin constant symbols
notes: Disjoint from the original language; distinct symbols may have equal values.

role: fresh Henkin individual constant
notes: The completed construction gives infinitely many names for each of their values.

role: finite conjunction of accumulated stage sentences
notes: The empty initial conjunction is true; each stage retains consistency.

role: enumerated formula for a witness requirement
notes: All expanded-language formulas with at most the displayed free variable occur.

role: least index of a constant absent from the current formula and stage
notes: Freshness is a syntactic condition on the actual finite sentences.

role: Henkin existential-witness sentence
notes: Retained on every atom and atomless branch.

role: listed nonprincipal complete types with their finite arities and countable index set
notes: Finite and empty lists are allowed; no nonprincipal zero-type exists for the standing complete T.

role: stage task combining a type flag and distinct constant symbols
notes: The empty flag selects only the atom or atomless tuple condition.

role: task constant tuple and remaining private constant tuple
notes: Syntactically disjoint name lists; their values need not be distinct.

role: accumulated finite stage together with its new witness sentence
notes: Its named-variable projection determines the next two-branch choice.

role: formula obtained by replacing the task and private constants by variables
notes: All bound variables are freshened before this replacement.

role: existential projection to the task variable slots
notes: Consistent projection; either contains an atom or is atomless.

role: countable theory specified in the current source construction
notes: In the simultaneous Henkin proof it is the new-constant base expansion; in section 4 it is the arbitrary target theory.

role: base expansion with every chosen simultaneous stage sentence
notes: Consistency follows from all finite stages and compactness.

role: infinite cardinal bounding the parameter-set size
notes: The finite-parameter convention is kappa equal to aleph zero.

role: relative interpretation on a definable domain
notes: Uses actual identity on the domain and definable relations; no quotient interpretation is inserted.

role: nonempty interpreted-domain formula
notes: Quantifier translations guard the interpreted domain.

role: formula defining an interpreted relation
notes: Its truth is used only at tuples of interpreted-domain elements.

role: formula selecting the unique interpreted distinguished element
notes: Explicit existence and uniqueness within the interpreted domain.

role: translated formula under the relative interpretation
notes: Truth preservation is supplied by a complete formula induction.

role: denotation of an interpretation in the target model
notes: The interpretation requirement makes it an infinite model of the standing T.

role: countable elementary extension meeting interpreted requirements
notes: Constructed as an actual inclusion by relabeling the elementary-diagram copy.

role: outer elementary-chain target stage
notes: Repeats the inner filling operation so new finite tuples are also covered.

role: inner elementary-chain stage for one fixed target's tasks
notes: Every old tuple requirement appears once in the countable inner enumeration.

role: union of the outer elementary chain
notes: Its interpreted domains commute with the union and satisfy all one-coordinate extension requirements.

role: nonzero node in a binary Boolean splitting tree
notes: Here s is a finite binary string; separate from the natural-number Henkin stage formula.

role: complete type extending the chosen infinite binary branch
notes: Disjoint sibling formulas ensure different branches give different types.

role: complete theory of dense linear order without endpoints
notes: Its finite tuple types are exactly the equality and strict-order patterns.

role: complete dense-order theory naming every rational
notes: Countable naming changes the empty-parameter type space and destroys smallness.

role: complete theory of the ordered natural numbers
notes: The prime calculation uses unique finite-position formulas rather than an unsupplied decision procedure.

role: formula saying exactly k predecessors
notes: Isolates the standard position k in the ordered natural model.

role: formula saying at least k predecessors
notes: Their consistent partial type is nonprincipal and every completion is omitted by the prime model.

role: complete independent-unary-predicate theory
notes: Every finite Boolean predicate pattern has infinitely many realizations.

role: indexed unary predicate
notes: Changing a previously unmentioned predicate gives two consistent refinements.

role: total single-valued graph relation replacing a function
notes: Zero-arity functions remain individual constants.

role: term-value formula in the graph language
notes: Term induction proves existence and uniqueness of its selected value.

role: translated theory together with all total graph axioms
notes: Its models correspond bijectively to the function-language models on the same domain.

role: listed nonprincipal partial type relative to an arbitrary satisfiable theory
notes: The broader omission theorem does not assume completeness or replace a partial type by an arbitrary completion.
